REQUIRED MATERIALS
Chemistry: The Central Science, 15th ed. A scientific calculator. Safety goggles
(available at the bookstore, approximately $12). Lab notebook, bound, carbonless.

COURSE POLICIES
Attendance at lecture is not taken, but attendance at every lab session is
mandatory. A missed lab cannot be made up except in documented emergencies.
Academic integrity: the Cornell Code of Academic Integrity applies in full.
Students with disabilities should contact Student Disability Services; I will
implement any accommodation letter I receive.

GRADING

Online homework (Mastering)  10%
Recitation quizzes           10%

SCHEDULE OF ASSESSMENTS

Online homework sets are due Sundays at 11:59 PM beginning August 30 and
continuing every week through November 29, except during fall break.

Recitation quizzes are given in recitation each Thursday beginning September 3.

Laboratory reports are due one week after the lab session, at the start of your
next lab.

LABORATORY SCHEDULE

Week 3 (Sep 8/10)  Lab 2: Stoichiometry of a precipitation reaction

MAKE-UP POLICY
There are no make-up prelims. If you miss a prelim with a documented excuse,
the final examination will be reweighted to cover it.
